newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South African airline objects to BA deal.
newsitem.headline: South African airline objects to BA deal.

text.p: South African Airways (SAA) said on Sunday it had lodged a formal complaint with licensing authorities over a franchise agreement between British Airways (BA) and local carrier Comair.
A statement said complaints had been lodged with the International Air Services Licensing Council and the South African equivalent.

"The franchise agreement would, if approved, legitimise a highly controversial, dubious international practice and would inevitably lead to major job losses in the South African aviation industry," the statement said.
SAA said the franchise agreement would allow BA to operate a service in South Africa without the appropriate licence, becoming in effect a South African domestic operator.

"Setting a precedent such as this will allow any international operator to franchise a nominal South African operator and to become a full participant in the South African domestic aviation market," SAA said.
